rule: Top-5 Chartink setups by 20-day win rate (5y backtest, 124,578 trades) · entry next open · +4% target / -2% stop / 20-session time exit · ₹10,000/trade · max 10 open, 5 new/day · EOD scan 17:50 IST
note: Signals scanned directly from completed NSE-500 daily bars (same conditions as the Chartink MAHI dashboard scans; setup column shows which rule fired). First scan 5 Nov 2026.

by_setup.label: BB Stack (M+W+D)
by_setup.rule: Monthly+Weekly+Daily close all above their upper Bollinger band(20,2) and above the prior bar, close <= open*1.16, prior turnover >= 40L

by_setup.label: Above Monthly BB
by_setup.rule: Daily close >= monthly upper BB(20,2) while the previous 2 monthly closes were below their BBs

by_setup.label: Swing Shashi
by_setup.rule: Weekly WMA(RSI9,21) < weekly EMA(RSI9,3) and < RSI9, close >= SMA20 for 6 days, 1-month-ago close above 1-month-ago upper BB, RSI14 >= 60

by_setup.label: Gap-up > Prev-High
by_setup.rule: Open >= previous day high, RSI14 >= RSI50, volume >= 10L, day change > 3%

by_setup.label: HM Positional
by_setup.rule: Monthly+Weekly+Daily WMA(RSI9,21) < RSI9, all three RSI9 > 50 and rising vs prior bar
